# VILab 0.3.1

## Fixes

- Fixed the floating dictation overlay falling back to the old generic processing state after Doubao streaming ASR finished.
- Kept the live ASR progress visible while `finish_recording` waits for the next realtime event, then moved to an explicit model-waiting stage before LLM post-processing starts.
- Streamed LLM post-processing deltas after ASR final so the user sees the cleanup result without replaying the full ASR transcript.
- Preserved the raw transcript when server-side post-processing fails, returning a warning instead of dropping the whole dictation result.

## Providers

- Added Doubao / Volcengine ASR provider support for App ID, Access Token, and realtime ASR parameters.
- Added Volcengine Ark LLM provider metadata and model discovery support.
- Clarified local Server and remote Server settings copy so clients use external API keys instead of admin keys.

## Packaging

- Windows installers continue to include local VILab Server support by building the desktop binary with the `server` feature.
